CustomField.description: Staging mirror of GiftCommitment.FQS_Match_Eligible__c. Written to the parent Gift Commitment (not the resulting Gift Transaction) on commit. The GC_ prefix disambiguates the mirror from any future FQS_Match_Eligible__c on the GT itself and makes the routing intent explicit. When TRUE, a corporate matching gift is expected against this commitment; downstream match-request flows read the flag to default their eligibility question.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check if a corporate matching gift is expected against the Gift Commitment being created. Populates the Match Eligible flag on the commitment, not on each individual transaction.
CustomField.label: GC Match Eligible
